profile.headline: Software Engineer | Full Stack & Backend Systems | Java, Spring Boot, Angular, TypeScript, Python, SQL | Financial Services Technology
profile.geoLocationName: Jersey City, New Jersey, United States
profile.summary:
Software Engineer with experience building enterprise applications, AI-powered tools, and scalable backend systems within financial services. Currently working at Brown Brothers Harriman developing full-stack and data-driven applications supporting enterprise operational workflows and large-scale data platforms.

My experience includes Java, Spring Boot, Angular, TypeScript, Python, SQL, REST APIs, and modern AI/data technologies including LangChain, RAG workflows, knowledge graphs, PySpark, Apache Spark, and Snowflake. I’ve worked on projects focused on enterprise automation, semantic search, metadata accessibility, and intelligent data processing.

I enjoy building scalable systems that sit at the intersection of software engineering, AI, and data platforms while collaborating closely with technical and business stakeholders to deliver practical, high-impact solutions.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
• Engineered and maintained enterprise MDM systems supporting 100K+ client records and mission-critical banking workflows with 99.9% uptime.

• Developed full-stack applications using Java, Spring Boot, Angular, TypeScript, SQL, and REST APIs, improving application performance by 30–40%.

• Delivered 15–20 business-driven features annually in collaboration with technical and business stakeholders, reducing manual operational workflows by ~25%.

• Modernized legacy APIs and backend services, reducing response times by ~35% and decreasing production defects by ~30%.

• Built scalable data-driven workflows and enterprise automation solutions supporting operational reporting, metadata accessibility, and internal platform integrations.

• Optimized high-volume export processes, reducing memory usage by 50% and increasing export capacity from 5K to 50K+ records.

• Collaborated with security and infrastructure teams to remediate high and critical vulnerabilities prior to production releases.

• Contributed to an internal AI-driven metadata accessibility initiative utilizing Python, semantic search, knowledge graph technologies, and RAG-based workflows to improve enterprise data discovery.

• Developed an automated address standardization solution using Python and data transformation workflows to improve operational efficiency and downstream data consistency.

projects.title: Financial KPI Forecasting & Analytics Dashboard
projects.description:
Built a Python-based forecasting and analytics platform to analyze the relationship between retail foot traffic, same-store sales, and revenue performance using historical business data.

Developed data pipelines and forecasting workflows using Python, Pandas, and Streamlit to clean, analyze, and visualize KPI trends. Evaluated predictive performance using MAE, RMSE, and R² metrics while identifying business insights around revenue predictability and operational trends.

Created an interactive dashboard for exploring forecasts, trend analysis, and business performance metrics to support data-driven decision-making.

projects.title: Global Address Standardization
projects.description:
Developed a system to restructure legacy MT599 SWIFT messages into modern MX, JSON, and XML formats.

Utilized Python, Streamlit, and libpostal to perform address standardization without reliance on paid AI APIs.

Decreased operational costs and storage requirements while maintaining extensibility for future AI integration.

Received Best Automation award in a company-wide competition.
